task: Independent frozen deep-crouch PPO provenance/normalizer audit; no simulation

documented_runtime_configuration_differe.multi_gpu: Checkpoint adds a runtime multi_gpu:null field absent from startup configuration; single-GPU behavior is unchanged.

timing_note: Checkpoint, last-update and final-status clocks are saved moments apart; final campaign duration is the manifest value.
reporting_limitations: Only supine starts count as ground recovery; deep, moderate and standing starts are curriculum stages.

Use sustained_clean_passes for full-duration CPU stage counts. It requires complete duration, at least one two-second clean hold, trajectory compliance and a clean final state. It does not assert uninterrupted standing through the episode or a fresh two-second hold immediately before the end.
First-attainment clean_balance_passes can remain positive after a later fall; they must not replace the full-duration count.

A noisy rollout can complete the full duration and be clean at its final sample while still failing the two-second continuous-hold requirement. Do not describe every unsuccessful noisy episode as a fall.
Posture and exact contact checks are sampled at 50 Hz; joint position, speed and commanded-effort audits run at 1000 Hz.
Noise standard deviations are in normalized action units, sampled independently every 20 ms before action clipping. They are not joint radians or external pushes.
Each five-seed group is a small controlled sample with fixed model and reset assumptions, not broad hardware or disturbance robustness.
GPU training success uses touch/geometric criteria and ends an episode after the clean hold. It is not a full-duration exact-contact CPU score.
Limit-pass counts for early-stopped failures cover only their observed prefixes.

The contact-normalization intervention precedes this PPO run. Actual parameter updates are verified here, but parameter changes alone do not prove a pass-count gain over that warm start; report matched ablation results separately.
evaluation_scope: Root owns final CPU evaluations and count comparisons; this audit verifies provenance, normalization and export consistency without adding simulation results.
